Rally_party.changelog:
Changes in Rally_party:
- Quest list shows names. Add a quest from the list on the right. Custom presets use the same list. 
- Optimization connect ld 14, and has Select All. 
- Back returns to account and quest settings. Bots keep running and pick up the new quest list.
- If a step cannot be finished, that account stops and waits for Continue. A screenshot goes to Telegram. 
- Gear is equipped only after the menu loads. 
- With several emulators, ADB reconnects after a drop.
